statement: Linux v6.12 distinguishes the Wii U Pro by the Nintendo RVL-CNT-01-UC HID name or the extension identity ending in 0x01 0x20, before fallback Wii Remote generation checks. It selects a dedicated Pro device type.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Pinned classifier and extension ID decoding; no physical Bluetooth discovery or readback.
